profile.name: Wafa Amjad
profile.title: Computer Science Student | Full Stack Developer
profile.bio: I am a Computer Science undergraduate at COMSATS University Islamabad, Abbottabad Campus, with practical experience in building full-stack web and mobile applications. I specialize in designing backend REST APIs, optimizing relational and non-relational databases, and crafting responsive user interfaces. I love solving algorithmic challenges and applying modern software engineering principles to real-world systems.
profile.long_bio: Pursuing my BS in Computer Science (2023-2027), I have developed a strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures, Algorithms, and Software Architecture. As a developer, I aim to build secure, robust, and scalable solutions that bridge the gap between high-level engineering designs and everyday utility. Through academic projects and professional internships, I have completed multiple full-stack systems with authentication, database integration, and high performance.

projects.title: Password Validation System
projects.short_description: A C-language tool demonstrating password rules enforcement and input validation.
projects.detailed_description: A programming system designed to validate passwords based on custom rules (length, upper/lowercase count, numeric presence, and special characters). It highlights fundamental C programming concepts, structural programming practices, string analysis, and low-level character parsing. Built to show command-line interface validation logic.
highlights: String processing algorithms in standard C
Multiple complexity-rule checking strategies
Robust input validation against buffers and special inputs

projects.title: Flight Reservation System
projects.short_description: A console-based reservation management application written in C.
projects.detailed_description: A terminal application developed in C to control mock flight records, passenger seating assignments, reservations, and ticket cancellations. Demonstrates file handling for data persistence, struct layout for object definition, and custom record search and updates using terminal interfaces.
highlights: Dynamic flight schedule scheduling and database simulation via binary file file I/O
Interactive passenger boarding and ticketing lists
Algorithmic seating chart mapping in standard Terminal output

projects.title: Blood Bank Management System
projects.short_description: A database-driven Java application for managing blood inventory and requests.
projects.detailed_description: An interactive desktop application built with Java Swing for administrative actions and a relational SQL database. It covers donor registration, matching blood type requirements, monitoring current inventory levels, tracking medical checkups, and record search. It uses JDBC for standard integration to run queries, store records, and retrieve reports.
highlights: Connected Java GUI with SQL server for secure CRUD transactions
Search queries with complex SQL filters regarding donor availability
State rendering to track blood group inventory alerts and shortages

projects.title: Lost and Found Portal
projects.short_description: A full-stack tracking service application using React, Node, and Supabase.
projects.detailed_description: A full-stack web application designed for campus crowdsourcing. It provides platforms where students can report lost property and claim discovered goods. Features include filters, categories, photo upload, and instant verification claims. Built with React for frontend rendering and Node/Express REST APIs for connecting to a Supabase database.
highlights: Responsive React frontend querying Express REST backend
Secure Supabase storage for uploading snapshots of found objects
Sorting/search by keyword, status (lost/found), and date

projects.title: Random Quote Generator
projects.short_description: A quote delivery web client built on React, Express, and MongoDB.
projects.detailed_description: A lightweight, dynamic application retrieving quotes based on author or category. Users can save quotes local, generate random items, or browse catalog details. Key operations are configured on a Node/Express backend that accesses MongoDB tables with Mongoose.
highlights: Internship project during full-stack contract
Mongoose aggregation queries retrieve quick random rows
Shareable links configuration for social pages

projects.title: Flashcard Quiz App
projects.short_description: Interactive study card trainer using React, Node, and MongoDB.
projects.detailed_description: A flashcard-based self-testing app providing quizzes across technical categories. Includes a custom session builder, countdown timers, responsive card flip animations, and real-time score keeping. Integrated with a REST API backend saving performance and card items into a cloud MongoDB instance.
highlights: Dynamic categorization mechanism for study sessions
Real-time countdown timer tracking test compliance
Clean, interactive CSS animations for flipping cards

projects.title: Sudoku Game
projects.short_description: A Python puzzle builder and automated solver based on Backtracking.
projects.detailed_description: An interactive Sudoku board game designed in Python. Users can play levels or click a button to view an instant solution. Solver logic is powered by a backtracking algorithm that visualizes constraint solving dynamically, demonstrating algorithmic speed and state manipulation.
highlights: Backtracking solver resolving grid constraints under 50ms
Interactive grid UI handling cell entry validations
Dynamic game board state generating novel boards on request

projects.title: Campus Utility Management System
projects.short_description: A complaint tracking system with role authentication and protected states.
projects.detailed_description: An enterprise-grade campus utility tracker connecting students, staff, and technicians. Students submit maintenance requests and ticket complaints, while administrators assign engineers to tickets and technicians modify resolution statuses. The React customer interface protects views using JWT auth cookies.
highlights: Designed role-based access logic for three different roles
Interactive dashboard for tracking status transitions of claims
Automated request timestamps and history audit pages

projects.title: Commutas — Smart Transit Mobile App
projects.short_description: A transit tracking mobile application using Flutter and Supabase.
projects.detailed_description: A mobile routing application for campus transit, providing GPS bus tracking, seat vacancy analysis, and a digital fare wallet. The project includes NFC-based contactless fare collection, integrated fallback QR codes, route maps, and a web admin dashboard.
highlights: Cross-platform Flutter app integrated with Supabase Realtime tracking
Contactless fare updates utilizing NFC cards with instant wallet sync
Administrative analytics panel managing fleet records and boarding stats

projects.title: Campus Ride Sharing Platform
projects.short_description: A ride-matching platform built with React, Node, and SQL Server.
projects.detailed_description: A full-scale ride sharing platform tailored for university students and faculty. Drivers publish open seats on transit plans while passengers search corresponding paths to join rides. The three-role dashboard manages authentication, rides tracking, distance matching, and status logging.
highlights: Three-role authentication: Admin, Driver, and Passenger dashboards
Relational route design using complex SQL Server indexing
Secure REST endpoints verify rider-passenger match parameters

responsibilities: Developed features for the 'Campus Ride Sharing Platform' using React and Node.js.
Built administrative modules for the 'Campus Utility Management System' using MongoDB.
Analyzed backend server performance and optimized query logic to reduce response latency.
Designed structured system architecture plans for multi-role user dashboards.
Worked in a fast-paced environment completing tasks with a 90% / Grade A final appraisal.
Engineered the Flashcard Quiz App with custom timers, scoring models, and flashcard categories.
Created a user interface and API for the Random Quote Generator based on React and MongoDB.
Created reusable React components and integrated REST endpoints to retrieve backend data.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
